characters.name: Karthik
characters.appearance: Young adult male with short dark hair and a medium build. He is seen mostly from behind, sitting cross-legged.
characters.wardrobe: Olive green t-shirt with text printed on the back, and blue jeans.
characters.demeanor: Attentive and eager to learn, occasionally showing surprise or realization.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Female-presenting humanoid robot. Silver metallic body with glowing blue circular accents on the chest and head. Smooth, metallic facial features.
characters.wardrobe: Built-in silver metallic plating with blue glowing circuitry lines.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Hello, what is your name?
Karthik says: My name is Karthik.
Miss Nova says: How old are you?
Karthik says: I have 22.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I have 22', you should say 'I am 22 years old'. I explain the logic in your own language so it makes sense.
Karthik says: Okay, okay. I am 22 years old.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Karthik says: I am Chennai.
Miss Nova says: It should be 'I am from Chennai'. Don't worry about mistakes. I am Miss Nova. I find where you struggle and build a personalized plan just for you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable Indian-English error and live correction.
- Payload beat (g): Logic explained in your language.
- Payload beat (a): Personalization introduced early.

Miss Nova says: It is seven times cheaper than regular English classes.
Miss Nova says: Plus, no one is watching. Make a thousand mistakes, and I will correct you without ever judging you.
Miss Nova says: That is why over one crore users trust Supernova AI.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Handles the cost objection with a comparative anchor.
- Payload beat (b): Privacy and no-judgement reassurance.
- Social proof: 1 crore+ users mentioned naturally.
